title: islaam ki hayaat ka haasil ghadeer hai
body:
islaam ki hayaat ka haasil ghadeer hai
sajdou me mere isliye shaamil ghadeer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sun le'n jo wo samjhte hai mushkil ghadeer hai
asaaniyou ki aaqri manzil ghadeer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
husne nazar jo ho to nazar aayega tumhe
ruqsaare deene haq ka hasee'n tal ghadeer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sacchaiyou ki jeet hai jhutou ki haar hai
eid e mubahela ke mamaasil ghadeer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
besaaqta quloos ne badh kar ye di sada
shikwe gilou ko chod gale mil ghadeer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aye munkire wila e ali tumse hai sawaal
jaaoge kaise quld muqabil ghadeer hai
